title: What is Film Noir – Private Detectives, Corrupt Cops, and Femme Fatales
speaker: StudioBinder
zh: 【StudioBinder】什麼是黑色電影——私家偵探、貪腐警察和蛇蠍美人（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: What is film noir?
cues.en: What is film noir?
cues.zh: 什麼是黑色電影？

cues.text: Is it a genre?
cues.en: Is it a genre?
cues.zh: 它是一種流派嗎？

cues.text: A style?
cues.en: A style?
cues.zh: 一種風格？

cues.text: Both?
cues.en: Both?
cues.zh: 兩個都？

cues.text: Or neither?
cues.en: Or neither?
cues.zh: 或者兩者都不是？

cues.text: Scholars have fiercely debated the issue.
cues.en: Scholars have fiercely debated the issue.
cues.zh: 學者們對此問題展開了激烈的爭論。

cues.text: Yet most agree that film noir can be identified by its pessimistic tone,
cues.en: Yet most agree that film noir can be identified by its pessimistic tone,
cues.zh: 然而大多數人都認為黑色電影可以透過其悲觀的基調來識別，

cues.text: morally grey themes, and high-contrast visuals that mix light and shadow.
cues.en: morally grey themes, and high-contrast visuals that mix light and shadow.
cues.zh: 道德灰色主題，以及混合光影的高對比視覺效果。

cues.text: Professor James Naremore summed up the issue nicely in saying,
cues.en: Professor James Naremore summed up the issue nicely in saying,
cues.zh: 詹姆斯·納雷莫爾教授很好地總結了這個問題，他說：

cues.text: It has always been easier to recognize a film noir than to define the term.
cues.en: It has always been easier to recognize a film noir than to define the term.
cues.zh: 識別黑色電影總是比定義這個術語更容易。

cues.text: Yet, despite contention to its classification, film noir's legacy
cues.en: Yet, despite contention to its classification, film noir's legacy
cues.zh: 然而，儘管對其分類存在爭議，黑色電影的遺產

cues.text: has been long-lasting, inspiring modern examples that subvert its
cues.en: has been long-lasting, inspiring modern examples that subvert its
cues.zh: 一直是持久的、鼓舞人心的顛覆其傳統的現代例子

cues.text: tropes and exaggerate its aesthetics.
cues.en: tropes and exaggerate its aesthetics.
cues.zh: 比喻並誇大其美感。

cues.text: Damn it, why are you smiling?
cues.en: Damn it, why are you smiling?
cues.zh: 該死的，你為什麼笑？

cues.text: Well, I'm trying to look sexy.
cues.en: Well, I'm trying to look sexy.
cues.zh: 嗯，我正在努力讓自己看起來性感。

cues.text: You're supposed to be dead.
cues.en: You're supposed to be dead.
cues.zh: 你應該死了。

cues.text: I know I can be dead and sexy.
cues.en: I know I can be dead and sexy.
cues.zh: 我知道我可以死而性感。

cues.text: We've seen the effects and influences of film noir for decades, in faithful
cues.en: We've seen the effects and influences of film noir for decades, in faithful
cues.zh: 幾十年來，我們忠實地看到了黑色電影的影響和影響

cues.text: recreations and biting satires.
cues.en: recreations and biting satires.
cues.zh: 娛樂和尖銳的諷刺。

cues.text: I've heard police work is dangerous.
cues.en: I've heard police work is dangerous.
cues.zh: 我聽說警察的工作很危險。

cues.text: It is, that's why I carry a big gun.
cues.en: It is, that's why I carry a big gun.
cues.zh: 是的，這就是為什麼我帶著一把大槍。

cues.text: What is it about film noir that has critics so divided?
cues.en: What is it about film noir that has critics so divided?
cues.zh: 黑色電影為何引起評論家如此分歧？

cues.text: Today, we're going to examine the elements and history that make noir, noir.
cues.en: Today, we're going to examine the elements and history that make noir, noir.
cues.zh: 今天，我們將探討造成黑色的元素和歷史。

cues.text: Film noir is defined by three main elements.
cues.en: Film noir is defined by three main elements.
cues.zh: 黑色電影由三個主要元素定義。

cues.text: Archetypal characters, high-contrast aesthetics, and complex stories with unhappy endings.
cues.en: Archetypal characters, high-contrast aesthetics, and complex stories with unhappy endings.
cues.zh: 典型的人物、高對比的美學、複雜的故事和不幸的結局。

cues.text: Film noirs feature a consistent cast of characters.
cues.en: Film noirs feature a consistent cast of characters.
cues.zh: 黑色電影的角色陣容一致。

cues.text: The private detective, an intelligent loner who plays by their own rules.
cues.en: The private detective, an intelligent loner who plays by their own rules.
cues.zh: 私家偵探，一個聰明的孤獨者，按照自己的規則行事。

cues.text: The femme fatale, a succubus who feeds on men lured into her web of deceit.
cues.en: The femme fatale, a succubus who feeds on men lured into her web of deceit.
cues.zh: 蛇蠍美人，一個以被引誘進入她的欺騙網的男人為食的魅魔。

cues.text: The corrupt cop, a law enforcement official who has abandoned their duty in pursuit of personal gain.
cues.en: The corrupt cop, a law enforcement official who has abandoned their duty in pursuit of personal gain.
cues.zh: 腐敗的警察，為了追求個人利益而放棄職責的執法官員。

cues.text: However, these character archetypes also appear in films few would call 'noir',
cues.en: However, these character archetypes also appear in films few would call 'noir',
cues.zh: 然而，這些角色原型也出現在很少人稱之為「黑色」的電影中，

cues.text: proving that they are just one element that contribute to making a film noir.
cues.en: proving that they are just one element that contribute to making a film noir.
cues.zh: 證明它們只是有助於製作黑色電影的元素之一。

cues.text: Visually, film noir is characterized by high-contrast aesthetics, stark
cues.en: Visually, film noir is characterized by high-contrast aesthetics, stark
cues.zh: 從視覺上看，黑色電影的特徵是高對比美學、鮮明的

cues.text: black and white cinematography exacerbated by chiaroscuro lighting.
cues.en: black and white cinematography exacerbated by chiaroscuro lighting.
cues.zh: 明暗照明加劇了黑白電影攝影的效果。

cues.text: This visual diametric serves a thematic purpose to show two ends of the
cues.en: This visual diametric serves a thematic purpose to show two ends of the
cues.zh: 這個視覺直徑的目的是為了顯示兩端

cues.text: spectrum and situate us in the middle.
cues.en: spectrum and situate us in the middle.
cues.zh: 頻譜並將我們置於中間。

cues.text: It's love at one.
cues.en: It's love at one.
cues.zh: 一開始就是愛。

cues.text: An old left-hand heat is down for the count.
cues.en: An old left-hand heat is down for the count.
cues.zh: 一場古老的左手比賽即將結束。

cues.text: Narratively, film noirs live in a middle area.
cues.en: Narratively, film noirs live in a middle area.
cues.zh: 從敘事角度來說，黑色電影生活在中間區域。

cues.text: There is no good or evil.
cues.en: There is no good or evil.
cues.zh: 沒有善惡之分。

cues.text: Only shades of moral gray.
cues.en: Only shades of moral gray.
cues.zh: 只有道德灰色地帶。

cues.text: Film noir also leverages expressionistic mise-en-scene, foggy exteriors with silhouette characters,
cues.en: Film noir also leverages expressionistic mise-en-scene, foggy exteriors with silhouette characters,
cues.zh: 黑色電影也利用了表現主義的場景排程、霧濛濛的外景和人物剪影，

cues.text: pronounced cigarette smoke, and messy interiors with light seeping through the Venetian blinds.
cues.en: pronounced cigarette smoke, and messy interiors with light seeping through the Venetian blinds.
cues.zh: 明顯的香菸煙霧，以及凌亂的內飾，光線透過百葉窗滲入。

cues.text: Alright, enough's enough.
cues.en: Alright, enough's enough.
cues.zh: 好吧，夠了夠了。

cues.text: You can't eat the Venetian blinds.
cues.en: You can't eat the Venetian blinds.
cues.zh: 你不能吃百葉窗。

cues.text: I just had 'em installed on Wednesday.
cues.en: I just had 'em installed on Wednesday.
cues.zh: 我週三才安裝的。

cues.text: These visual tropes are essential, but not exclusive to noir.
cues.en: These visual tropes are essential, but not exclusive to noir.
cues.zh: 這些視覺比喻是不可或缺的，但並非黑色電影所獨有。

cues.text: Film noirs have complex narratives with unhappy endings.
cues.en: Film noirs have complex narratives with unhappy endings.
cues.zh: 黑色電影有著複雜的敘事和不幸的結局。

cues.text: Splintering stories in which the antagonist might get caught
cues.en: Splintering stories in which the antagonist might get caught
cues.zh: 支離破碎的故事，其中的對手可能會被抓住

cues.text: but protagonists doesn't get what they want.
cues.en: but protagonists doesn't get what they want.
cues.zh: 但主角並沒有得到他們想要的東西。

cues.text: This pessimistic convention isn't quite tragic in the classical sense, but it is distinctly unhappy.
cues.en: This pessimistic convention isn't quite tragic in the classical sense, but it is distinctly unhappy.
cues.zh: 這種悲觀的慣例在古典意義上並不十分悲慘，但它顯然令人不快。

cues.text: Film noirs feature themes of alienation, existentialism, and moral ambiguity,
cues.en: Film noirs feature themes of alienation, existentialism, and moral ambiguity,
cues.zh: 黑色電影的主題是疏離、存在主義和道德模糊性，

cues.text: but their plot structures are varied.
cues.en: but their plot structures are varied.
cues.zh: 但他們的情節結構各不相同。

cues.text: Some start 'in-medias-res' and utilize flashbacks to illuminate
cues.en: Some start 'in-medias-res' and utilize flashbacks to illuminate
cues.zh: 有些開始“in-medias-res”並利用閃回來照亮

cues.text: background detail, while others move forward in chronological order.
cues.en: background detail, while others move forward in chronological order.
cues.zh: 背景細節，而其他人則按時間順序向前推進。

cues.text: Both strategies typically feature twists where evidence recontextualizes what we thought we knew, and characters
cues.en: Both strategies typically feature twists where evidence recontextualizes what we thought we knew, and characters
cues.zh: 這兩種策略通常都以曲折為特徵，其中證據重新背景化了我們認為我們知道的事情，而角色

cues.text: return from beyond the grave.
cues.en: return from beyond the grave.
cues.zh: 從墳墓外回來。

cues.text: What are you doing here?
cues.en: What are you doing here?
cues.zh: 你在這裡做什麼？

cues.text: You're alive.
cues.en: You're alive.
cues.zh: 你還活著。

cues.text: If you don't get out at once, I'm going to call the police.
cues.en: If you don't get out at once, I'm going to call the police.
cues.zh: 如果你不馬上出去，我就報警了。

cues.text: Film noirs often end on good and bad notes, where the main character
cues.en: Film noirs often end on good and bad notes, where the main character
cues.zh: 黑色電影通常以好與壞的音符結尾，主角

cues.text: is allowed to live, but forced to grapple with a horrible guilt.
cues.en: is allowed to live, but forced to grapple with a horrible guilt.
cues.zh: 被允許活著，但被迫與可怕的罪惡感作鬥爭。

cues.text: The aftertaste is bitter all the same.
cues.en: The aftertaste is bitter all the same.
cues.zh: 後味依然苦澀。

cues.text: Forget it, Jake. It's Chinatown.
cues.en: Forget it, Jake. It's Chinatown.
cues.zh: 忘了它吧，傑克。這是唐人街。

cues.text: These endings ask us to question the nature of good and evil.
cues.en: These endings ask us to question the nature of good and evil.
cues.zh: 這些結局要求我們質疑善與惡的本質。

cues.text: For how could such a binary exist when things end so murky and confused?
cues.en: For how could such a binary exist when things end so murky and confused?
cues.zh: 當事情的結局如此模糊和混亂時，這樣的二元結構怎麼可能存在？

cues.text: According to authors Tony Nourmand and Paul Duncan, not everything is about love
cues.en: According to authors Tony Nourmand and Paul Duncan, not everything is about love
cues.zh: 根據作家託尼努爾曼和保羅鄧肯的說法，並非一切都與愛情有關

cues.text: and hate, not everything is good and bad.
cues.en: and hate, not everything is good and bad.
cues.zh: 和恨，並不是一切都是好是壞。

cues.text: More often than not, these noir characters live in the ambiguous gray area in between.
cues.en: More often than not, these noir characters live in the ambiguous gray area in between.
cues.zh: 通常，這些黑色人物生活在兩者之間模糊的灰色地帶。

cues.text: People lose teeth talking like that.
cues.en: People lose teeth talking like that.
cues.zh: 人們這樣說話會掉牙。

cues.text: If you want to hang around, you'll be polite.
cues.en: If you want to hang around, you'll be polite.
cues.zh: 如果你想閒逛，你就會有禮貌。

cues.text: A movie doesn't have to be noir to have an unhappy ending, but you'd be hard-pressed
cues.en: A movie doesn't have to be noir to have an unhappy ending, but you'd be hard-pressed
cues.zh: 電影不一定要黑色才會有不愉快的結局，但你會感到壓力很大

cues.text: to find many noirs with happy endings.
cues.en: to find many noirs with happy endings.
cues.zh: 找到許多結局皆大歡喜的黑色電影。

cues.text: Character archetypes, high-contrast aesthetics, and complex narratives with pessimistic endings are major elements of film noir.
cues.en: Character archetypes, high-contrast aesthetics, and complex narratives with pessimistic endings are major elements of film noir.
cues.zh: 人物原型、高對比美學以及帶有悲觀結局的複雜敘事是黑色電影的主要元素。

cues.text: But is it a style or a genre?
cues.en: But is it a style or a genre?
cues.zh: 但這是一種風格還是一種流派？

cues.text: Pro-genre critics point to the repetition of plots, settings, characters,
cues.en: Pro-genre critics point to the repetition of plots, settings, characters,
cues.zh: 支援型別的評論家指出情節、背景、人物的重複，

cues.text: and aesthetics as proof that film noir constitutes its own genre.
cues.en: and aesthetics as proof that film noir constitutes its own genre.
cues.zh: 和美學證明黑色電影構成了自己的型別。

cues.text: As Foster Hirsch writes, a genre is determined by conventions of
cues.en: As Foster Hirsch writes, a genre is determined by conventions of
cues.zh: 正如福斯特·赫希（Foster Hirsch）所寫，流派是由慣例決定的

cues.text: narrative structure, characterization, theme, and visual design.
cues.en: narrative structure, characterization, theme, and visual design.
cues.zh: 敘事結構、人物塑造、主題與視覺設計。

cues.text: Conversely, pro-style critics argue that those elements can and do exist
cues.en: Conversely, pro-style critics argue that those elements can and do exist
cues.zh: 相反，支援風格的批評家認為這些元素可以而且確實存在

cues.text: separately, in different combinations, and or in distinct genres altogether.
cues.en: separately, in different combinations, and or in distinct genres altogether.
cues.zh: 單獨地、以不同的組合、和/或完全以不同的流派。

cues.text: According to R. Barton Palmer, Whatever the noir element in a film is, it can be
cues.en: According to R. Barton Palmer, Whatever the noir element in a film is, it can be
cues.zh: 根據 R. Barton Palmer 的說法，無論電影中的黑色元素是什麼，它都可以是

cues.text: expressed through a number of genres.
cues.en: expressed through a number of genres.
cues.zh: 透過多種流派來表達。

cues.text: Melodrama, thriller, etc.
cues.en: Melodrama, thriller, etc.
cues.zh: 情節劇、驚悚片等

cues.text: And so, film noir is not itself a genre.
cues.en: And so, film noir is not itself a genre.
cues.zh: 因此，黑色電影本身並不是一種型別。

cues.text: Bless me, father, for I have sinned.
cues.en: Bless me, father, for I have sinned.
cues.zh: 父親，請保佑我，因為我犯了罪。

cues.text: Ultimately, the film noir genre versus style debate represents a
cues.en: Ultimately, the film noir genre versus style debate represents a
cues.zh: 最終，黑色電影型別與風格的爭論代表了一種

cues.text: greater point about how we study film.
cues.en: greater point about how we study film.
cues.zh: 關於我們如何研究電影的更重要的一點。

cues.text: How do we historicize and taxonomize the medium?
cues.en: How do we historicize and taxonomize the medium?
cues.zh: 我們如何對媒材進行歷史化與分類？

cues.text: Well, we look to the past to contextualize the present.
cues.en: Well, we look to the past to contextualize the present.
cues.zh: 好吧，我們回顧過去，以瞭解現在的情況。

cues.text: In 1946, French film critic Nino Frank used the term 'film noir' to describe
cues.en: In 1946, French film critic Nino Frank used the term 'film noir' to describe
cues.zh: 1946年，法國影評人尼諾·弗蘭克用“黑色電影”一詞來形容

cues.text: a series of four Hollywood crime dramas, 'The Maltese Falcon', Laura',
cues.en: a series of four Hollywood crime dramas, 'The Maltese Falcon', Laura',
cues.zh: 一系列四部好萊塢犯罪劇，《馬耳他之鷹》，《勞拉》，

cues.text: 'Murder, My Sweet', and 'Double Indemnity'.
cues.en: 'Murder, My Sweet', and 'Double Indemnity'.
cues.zh: 《謀殺，親愛的》和《雙重賠償》。

cues.text: Frank suggested that these films were psychological narratives that
cues.en: Frank suggested that these films were psychological narratives that
cues.zh: 弗蘭克認為這些電影是心理敘事

cues.text: mirrored real life in a way the police procedurals of the era never could.
cues.en: mirrored real life in a way the police procedurals of the era never could.
cues.zh: 以當時警察程式無法做到的方式反映了現實生活。

cues.text: He also observed that film noirs utilized narrators to slide
cues.en: He also observed that film noirs utilized narrators to slide
cues.zh: 他也觀察到黑色電影利用敘述者來滑動

cues.text: rapidly over transitional scenes and to accentuate the sense of living the character's experiences.
cues.en: rapidly over transitional scenes and to accentuate the sense of living the character's experiences.
cues.zh: 快速過渡場景並強調角色經驗的感覺。

cues.text: They don't advertise for killers in a newspaper.
cues.en: They don't advertise for killers in a newspaper.
cues.zh: 他們不會在報紙上刊登招募殺手的廣告。

cues.text: That was my profession.
cues.en: That was my profession.
cues.zh: 那是我的職業。

cues.text: Ex cop.
cues.en: Ex cop.
cues.zh: 前警察。

cues.text: Ex blade runner.
cues.en: Ex blade runner.
cues.zh: 前銀翼殺手。

cues.text: Ex killer.
cues.en: Ex killer.
cues.zh: 前殺手。

cues.text: Frank's writing gave classification to film noir, but the term wasn't
cues.en: Frank's writing gave classification to film noir, but the term wasn't
cues.zh: 弗蘭克的著作對黑色電影進行了分類，但這個術語並不是

cues.text: widely used until decades after its original invocation when writers like
cues.en: widely used until decades after its original invocation when writers like
cues.zh: 廣泛使用，直到最初呼叫幾十年後，當作家喜歡

cues.text: Paul Schrader detailed its history in academic papers and implemented its
cues.en: Paul Schrader detailed its history in academic papers and implemented its
cues.zh: 保羅·施拉德 (Paul Schrader) 在學術論文中詳細介紹了其歷史，並實施了其

cues.text: narrative style in his own scripts.
cues.en: narrative style in his own scripts.
cues.zh: 他自己劇本中的敘事風格。

cues.text: Now that we know what constitutes film noir, let's analyze where it came from.
cues.en: Now that we know what constitutes film noir, let's analyze where it came from.
cues.zh: 現在我們知道什麼是黑色電影，讓我們來分析它的來源。

cues.text: Why are the films so dark, and the stories and characters so pessimistic?
cues.en: Why are the films so dark, and the stories and characters so pessimistic?
cues.zh: 為什麼電影如此黑暗，故事和人物如此悲觀？

cues.text: I had to turn my back on the old lady, on the veils, on the ghosts, on the
cues.en: I had to turn my back on the old lady, on the veils, on the ghosts, on the
cues.zh: 我只好背對老太太、面紗、鬼魂、

cues.text: dead, before they all sucked me in.
cues.en: dead, before they all sucked me in.
cues.zh: 在他們把我吸進去之前就死了。

cues.text: Film noir grew out of a tradition of detective fiction in which writers like Edgar Allan Poe, Sir Arthur Conan Doyle, and Agatha Christie
cues.en: Film noir grew out of a tradition of detective fiction in which writers like Edgar Allan Poe, Sir Arthur Conan Doyle, and Agatha Christie
cues.zh: 黑色電影起源於偵探小說的傳統，其中作家如愛倫坡、阿瑟·柯南·道爾爵士和阿加莎·克里斯蒂

cues.text: introduced eccentric investigators obsessed with solving crimes.
cues.en: introduced eccentric investigators obsessed with solving crimes.
cues.zh: 引進了一位沉迷於破案的古怪調查員。

cues.text: Who can assist me?

cues.text: However, it wasn't these author's creations that proved noir's greatest influence,

cues.zh: 而是達希爾·哈米特、雷蒙德筆下的冷酷偵探

cues.text: Chandler, Chester Gould, Sam Spade, Philip Marlowe, and Dick Tracy, all

cues.text: even made the leap to the silver screen.

cues.en: Films like 'The Cabinet of Dr. Caligari' and 'The Testament of Dr. Mabuse',
cues.zh: 電影如《卡里加里博士的內閣》和《馬布斯博士的遺囑》，

cues.en: for example, incorporated surreal, high-contrast light and shadow to displace the viewer outside reality.

cues.en: This aesthetic gave visual language to German post-World War I anxiety.
cues.zh: 這種美學為德國人在第一次世界大戰後的焦慮提供了視覺語言。

cues.text: During Adolf Hitler's rise to power, directors like Otto Preminger, Billy
cues.en: During Adolf Hitler's rise to power, directors like Otto Preminger, Billy
cues.zh: 在阿道夫·希特勒上臺期間，奧託·普雷明格、比利等導演

cues.text: Wilder, and Fritz Lang fled Europe and moved to Hollywood, and they brought
cues.en: Wilder, and Fritz Lang fled Europe and moved to Hollywood, and they brought
cues.zh: 懷爾德和弗裡茨朗逃離歐洲搬到好萊塢，他們帶來了

cues.text: their signature blend of expressionistic filmmaking to American cinema.
cues.en: their signature blend of expressionistic filmmaking to American cinema.
cues.zh: 他們標誌性地將表現主義電影製作與美國電影融為一體。

cues.text: By the early 1940s, Hollywood had begun leveraging similar cinematographic
cues.en: By the early 1940s, Hollywood had begun leveraging similar cinematographic
cues.zh: 到了 20 世紀 40 年代初，好萊塢已經開始利用類似的電影技術

cues.text: techniques to relay anger and frustration with the Second World War.
cues.en: techniques to relay anger and frustration with the Second World War.
cues.zh: 傳達對第二次世界大戰的憤怒和沮喪的技巧。

cues.text: Film noir is also a product of war and post-war pessimism.
cues.en: Film noir is also a product of war and post-war pessimism.
cues.zh: 黑色電影也是戰爭和戰後悲觀主義的產物。

cues.text: Noirs of this era, which is typically called the classical era, sought
cues.en: Noirs of this era, which is typically called the classical era, sought
cues.zh: 這個時代（通常被稱為古典時代）的黑色電影尋求

cues.text: to capture a signature dark mood.
cues.en: to capture a signature dark mood.
cues.zh: 捕捉標誌性的黑暗情緒。

cues.en: In fact, 'film noir' translates from French as 'dark film'.

cues.text: These stories portray American society at a cultural crossroads.
cues.en: These stories portray American society at a cultural crossroads.
cues.zh: 這些故事描繪了處於文化十字路口的美國社會。

cues.text: Film scholar and critic Paul Arthur spoke about this phenomenon in the documentary series 'American Cinema'.
cues.en: Film scholar and critic Paul Arthur spoke about this phenomenon in the documentary series 'American Cinema'.
cues.zh: 電影學者兼評論家保羅·阿瑟在系列紀錄片《美國電影》中談到了這一現象。

cues.text: And what he discovers when he comes back from the war is not a secure place in society but rather quite the opposite.
cues.en: And what he discovers when he comes back from the war is not a secure place in society but rather quite the opposite.
cues.zh: 當他從戰爭中歸來時，他發現社會上不是一個安全的地方，而是相反。

cues.text: One sees it, in a sense, as the continuing experience of wartime
cues.en: One sees it, in a sense, as the continuing experience of wartime
cues.zh: 從某種意義上說，人們將其視為戰時的持續經歷

cues.text: trauma in a domestic situation.
cues.en: trauma in a domestic situation.
cues.zh: 家庭環境中的創傷。

cues.text: As women entered the labor market, jobs became scarce, and people
cues.en: As women entered the labor market, jobs became scarce, and people

cues.text: opportunities for crime and corruption.

cues.text: Film noir stories are situated here, within the moral quicksand created by World War II and the socio-political effects of the time.
cues.en: Film noir stories are situated here, within the moral quicksand created by World War II and the socio-political effects of the time.
cues.zh: 黑色電影故事發生在二戰造成的道德流沙和當時的社會政治影響。

cues.text: Yet, film noirs were not as graphic as you might think.
cues.en: Yet, film noirs were not as graphic as you might think.
cues.zh: 然而，黑色電影並不像你想像的那麼生動。

cues.text: The Motion Picture Production Code, or Hays Code, censored what was allowed in Hollywood films.
cues.en: The Motion Picture Production Code, or Hays Code, censored what was allowed in Hollywood films.
cues.zh: 電影製作法典（或稱海斯法典）審查了好萊塢電影中允許的內容。

cues.text: Crucially, it stated that no picture shall be produced which will lower the
cues.en: Crucially, it stated that no picture shall be produced which will lower the
cues.zh: 至關重要的是，它指出不得製作任何會降低價格的圖片

cues.text: moral standards of those who see it.
cues.en: moral standards of those who see it.
cues.zh: 看到它的人的道德標準。

cues.text: Hence, the sympathy of the audience should never be thrown to the side
cues.en: Hence, the sympathy of the audience should never be thrown to the side
cues.zh: 因此，觀眾的同情心永遠不應該被拋在一邊。

cues.text: of crime, wrongdoing, evil, or sin.
cues.en: of crime, wrongdoing, evil, or sin.
cues.zh: 犯罪、不法行為、邪惡或罪惡。

cues.text: Film noirs showcased organized crime within urban landscapes and
cues.en: Film noirs showcased organized crime within urban landscapes and
cues.zh: 黑色電影展示了城市景觀中的組織犯罪和

cues.text: featured everyday characters, ordinary people, struggling with real issues.
cues.en: featured everyday characters, ordinary people, struggling with real issues.
cues.zh: 以日常人物、一般人為特色，與現實問題奮戰。

cues.text: But their narratives and visuals had to comply with the code, which meant explicit content was kept to a minimum.
cues.en: But their narratives and visuals had to comply with the code, which meant explicit content was kept to a minimum.
cues.zh: 但他們的敘述和視覺效果必須符合規範，這意味著露骨的內容要保持在最低限度。

cues.text: Thus, film noirs of the classical era assumed a diluted tone.
cues.en: Thus, film noirs of the classical era assumed a diluted tone.
cues.zh: 因此，古典時代的黑色電影呈現出淡化的基調。

cues.text: It wasn't until the code was abolished that institutions of power were more flagrantly targeted.
cues.en: It wasn't until the code was abolished that institutions of power were more flagrantly targeted.
cues.zh: 直到該法典被廢除，權力機構才成為更公然的攻擊目標。

cues.text: There are all kinds of policemen, sir.
cues.en: There are all kinds of policemen, sir.
cues.zh: 警察有各種各樣的人，先生。

cues.text: I don't have to tell you that.
cues.en: I don't have to tell you that.
cues.zh: 我不必告訴你這一點。

cues.text: A few take bribes.
cues.en: A few take bribes.

cues.text: Hank Quinlan never took a bribe in his life.
cues.en: Hank Quinlan never took a bribe in his life.
cues.zh: 漢克昆蘭一生從未受過賄賂。

cues.text: Most are honest, yes, but even some of the honest men abuse
cues.en: Most are honest, yes, but even some of the honest men abuse
cues.zh: 是的，大多數人都是誠實的，但即使是一些誠實的人也會濫用權力

cues.text: their power in other ways.
cues.en: their power in other ways.
cues.zh: 他們在其他方面的力量。

cues.en: Film noir stretched beyond the American border during the classical period, evidenced in films like Akira Kurosawa's 'Stray Dog',

cues.text: Jules Descens, 'Rififi', and Lucino Visconti's 'Ossessione'.
cues.en: Jules Descens, 'Rififi', and Lucino Visconti's 'Ossessione'.
cues.zh: 朱爾斯·德森斯的《Rififi》和盧西諾·維斯康蒂的《Ossessione》。

cues.text: Film noir has been immortalized by the neo-noir movement, which renovated
cues.en: Film noir has been immortalized by the neo-noir movement, which renovated
cues.zh: 黑色電影因新黑色運動而永垂不朽，該運動革新了

cues.zh: 透過流派混搭和圖形視覺效果來體現其祖先的許多比喻。

cues.text: Jean Luc Godard's 'Alphaville', for example, incorporated elements of science fiction,
cues.en: Jean Luc Godard's 'Alphaville', for example, incorporated elements of science fiction,

cues.text: as did Ridley Scott's 'Blade Runner'.
cues.en: as did Ridley Scott's 'Blade Runner'.

cues.text: Must be expensive.

cues.text: Very.
cues.en: Very.
cues.zh: 非常。

cues.text: While David Fincher's 'Se7en' dialed up the grotesqueness in a way

cues.text: that would not have been permitted under the production code.
cues.en: that would not have been permitted under the production code.
cues.zh: 這在生產法規中是不允許的。

cues.text: The Coen Brothers have embraced noir elements throughout their career, with cold-blooded thrillers like 'Blood Simple'.
cues.en: The Coen Brothers have embraced noir elements throughout their career, with cold-blooded thrillers like 'Blood Simple'.

cues.text: Or classical homages like 'The Man Who Wasn't There',
cues.en: Or classical homages like 'The Man Who Wasn't There',

cues.en: and even comedies like 'The Big Lebowski'.

cues.en: We even see the influence of noir in more contemporary mediums.

cues.text: Such as television and video games.
cues.en: Such as television and video games.

cues.text: But what do you think is noir more of a genre or a style?
cues.en: But what do you think is noir more of a genre or a style?

cues.en: Thinking about incorporating some elements of film noir in your next project.
